# Lab 7.10: Create a Custom Role

## What We Are Going to Do
Build a custom role that can start and stop VMs but not create or delete them, then assign and test it.

## Steps

1. **Write the role definition.** Create `vm-operator.yaml`:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • YAML
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">title: "VM Operator"
description: "Start, stop and view VMs only"
stage: "GA"
includedPermissions:
- compute.instances.get
- compute.instances.list
- compute.instances.start
- compute.instances.stop
- compute.zones.list</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Create the role in the project.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam roles create vmOperator \
  --project=$PROJECT_ID \
  --file=vm-operator.yaml</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Grant it to Bob.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID \
  --member=user:bob@YOUR_DOMAIN \
  --role=projects/$PROJECT_ID/roles/vmOperator</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Create a VM to test with.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances create role-lab-vm --zone=us-central1-a --machine-type=e2-micro</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Test as Bob.** Sign in as Bob in a private window. Open **Compute Engine → VM instances**. Bob can stop and start `role-lab-vm`, but **Create instance** and **Delete** fail.

6. **Update the role.** Add a permission without recreating the role.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam roles update vmOperator --project=$PROJECT_ID \
  --add-permissions=compute.instances.reset</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


7. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances delete role-lab-vm --zone=us-central1-a --quiet
gcloud iam roles delete vmOperator --project=$PROJECT_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Start and stop | Allowed |
| Create and delete | Denied |
| Role ID | Cannot be reused for 37 days after deletion |
| Maintenance | You must update custom roles yourself |
